title: One way
opens_when: Karen has sold Frank a ticket or seen him at the landing twice

lines: A car at five on Thursday, and not a word to Mrs Rennison.

ends.town_keeps: she hates the Hook a little more, and him

ends.choice: pay her fortnight and send the car
